rationale: Characterize unchanged model-specific full and predeclared ablation variants after the local tensor gate passed; do not optimize or select from outcomes.

stopping: Preflight must complete without cellfailure. Full matrix starts only if 12*measured preflight wall plus a 120second verification reserve fits remaining session budget.
